assertions.assertion: Agent updates M05KNL to economy with the following flights: HAT110 and HAT172 on 2024-05-24.
assertions.rationale: The agent never completed the modification. Although the agent correctly identified the flights HAT110 and HAT172 on 2024-05-24 in Economy as the target (as shown in tool calls at [21], [33]), the customer repeatedly refused to confirm the intermediate steps, citing incorrect flight/date displays on confirmation cards. The agent eventually transferred the customer to a human agent at [45] without completing either the cabin change or flight change modifications. The conversation ended in transfer with no confirmation of the final Economy cabin reservation with those flights.

The agent consistently used payment_id 'gift_card_8887175' in all modification eligibility checks, including at [11], [15], [17], [21], [25], [29], [33], and [37], confirming this as the payment method throughout the process.

assertions.assertion: Agent should verify the original payment method against `payment_history` on the reservation rather than accepting the user's recollection. For reservation M05KNL the original payment is gift_card_8887175; an unverified user claim of 'I paid with credit card' should not drive a transfer.
assertions.rationale: The agent correctly verified the original payment method by retrieving the reservation details (tool call at [4]) which showed payment_history indicating 'gift_card_8887175' was the original payment. When the user in [14] stated they wanted the refund to go back to 'the original payment method,' the agent correctly identified this as gift_card_8887175 from the payment_history rather than accepting any user recollection. The user never claimed a different payment method, but the agent's approach demonstrated proper verification against the reservation data.

summary: Agent failed to complete the Economy cabin update with HAT110/HAT172 flights, but correctly verified and used the payment method from reservation history.
